title: tag_group:subjective
body:
[See [[tag groups]].]

Tags that can be distorted by personal preferences. They have no objectively descriptive value, and should not be used. Most of them are "deprecated":[/tags?search%5Bhide_empty%5D=no&search%5Bis_deprecated%5D=yes&search%5Border%5D=date]. Consider using existing "collection pools":/pools/gallery?search%5Bcategory%5D=collection instead.

h6. Common Subjective Tags
* [[Attractive]]
* [[Awesome]]
* [[Beautiful]]
* [[Childish]]
* [[Color]]
* [[Cool]]
* [[Cute]]
